newsitem.title: CANADA: Potash to buy US$340 mln of Arcadian notes.
newsitem.headline: Potash to buy US$340 mln of Arcadian notes.

text.p: Potash Corp of Saskatchewan said on Monday that it plans to make a cash offer to buy all of the US$340 million principal amount of 10-3/4 percent senior notes due 2005 of an Arcadian Corp subsidiary as part of a proposed merger.

Under the proposed terms of the offer, a subsidiary of Potash plans to offer holders of the notes a total cash consideration, including consent fees, for each US$1,000 principal amount of outstanding notes of (a) the present value of the Senior Notes determined by discounting future interest payments and principal payment (including prepayment premium) through May 1, 1998 (the first call date'' of the Senior Notes) at a discount rate equal to the yield on the applicable U.S. Treasury Note plus 75 basis points; plus (b) accrued and unpaid interest, if any, through the acceptance date of the debt tender offer.

Potash intends to begin its debt tender offer at the same time at which proxy materials concerning the merger with Arcadian are mailed to its shareholders. The debt tender offer will be made subject to the satisfaction or waiver of certain conditions including the consummation of the merger with Arcadian, which is expected to occur in early 1997. The acceptance date of the debt tender offer is expected to be on or about the effective date of the merger.

The full terms and conditions of the debt tender offer will be set forth in the offer to purchase and consent solicitation statement and related documents. Notes may be tendered and consents delivered only in accordance with the terms, conditions and instructions set forth in the documents, Potash said. ((Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8100))
